title: PipeshubRecordAccessQuery
description: Body of the query service's POST /api/v1/records/access (P1b C-6, C-18; SS0): which cited sources and which artifacts the caller may read now. Whose access is checked comes from the bearer token only. recordIds is the C-6 form, kept for older callers; references are typed sources; artifactIds are artifacts shown in a conversation the caller does not own, decided by their provenance.

artifactIds.description: Artifact (record) ids. Each counts toward the same 1000-item cap as recordIds and references.

CheckedSource.description: A source the authority decides: a record or a live fetch. A web page is never asked about.
